BiblicalUsage: Chalaza is hail, and in Revelation it falls three times. Hail and fire mingled with blood came at the first trumpet, lightnings and earthquake and great hail when the temple opened, and a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent, at the last bowl.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hail in Revelation is the old plague grown to the size of judgment: stones like talents falling on men who will not repent, and still they blaspheme God. The hail grows heavier through the book, and the hearts grow harder with it.
RelatedEvents: The Seven Trumpets; The Seven Bowls
